The share model is identity: one share is one bond token, and      the \"asset\" is the instrument's configured `cashToken`.COMPLETE NAV is the bond token's accounting value INCLUDING coupon accrual, coupon-pool amounts and      accrued fees. It is the feed's job to represent that; this contract cannot verify it and must not be      pointed at a catalog price or an executable quote. See `IGyldNavFeed`.THE STALENESS SPLIT, which is the whole design. The brief requires that a missing or stale price blocks      unsupported valuations and new NAV-sensitive actions WHILE PRESERVING VISIBLE HOLDINGS. A blanket revert      would also break price-per-share publication and withdrawals, which is not what is wanted. So:        - IDENTITY reads never revert: `decimals`, `getBalanceOfOwner`, `previewNav`. Holdings stay visible          and a suspended instrument still shows its balance.        - VALUE reads always revert when the price is unsupported: `getPricePerShare`, `getAssetOutput`,          `getShareOutput`, `getWithdrawalShareOutput`, `getTVLByOwnerOfShares`, `getTVL`.        - The inherited `getTVLByOwnerOfSharesMultiple` already converts a per-item revert into a `succeeded`          flag, so the pricing pipeline declines to publish rather than publishing a wrong number.        - `previewNav` returns a non-reverting status with a `failureCode`, so the guard hook and the OMS get          an actionable reason without decoding a revert.FEES ARE BYPASSED, exactly as `ERC20YieldSourceOracle` does. This oracle MUST be configured with      `feePercent = 0` and `FlatFeeLedger` is categorically forbidden: a bond's coupon accrual is not      performance yield and must never be charged as such. Combined with NONACCOUNTING trade hooks, the      ledger never touches this oracle, so a suspended instrument cannot brick accounting.NEVER ASSUMES CASH EQUALS ONE DOLLAR. decimals(address).details: Identity read: the bond token's own decimals. Never consults a feed.

params.yieldSourceAddress: The address of the yield-bearing token contract

returns._0: decimals The number of decimals used by the yield source's share token

getAssetOutput(address,address,uint256).details: Rounds DOWN: value out of the vault is never overstated.

params.assetIn: The underlying asset to receive (e.g., USDC, DAI)
params.sharesIn: The amount of yield-bearing shares to redeem
params.yieldSourceAddress: The yield-bearing token address (e.g., aUSDC, cDAI)

returns._0: assets The number of underlying assets that would be received

getAssetOutputWithFees(bytes32,address,a.details: FEES BYPASSED, deliberately and identically to `ERC20YieldSourceOracle`. Coupon accrual is not      performance yield. This oracle must be registered with `feePercent = 0`.

getBalanceOfOwner(address,address).details: Identity read, and the "preserve visible holdings" escape hatch: a suspended, stale or      unregistered instrument still reports the balance a strategy holds.

params.ownerOfShares: The address to check the balance for

returns._0: balance The number of yield-bearing tokens owned by the address

getPricePerShare(address).details: Core function for calculating yields and determining returns

params.yieldSourceAddress: The yield-bearing token address to get the price for

returns._0: pricePerShare The current price per share in underlying asset terms, scaled by decimals

getPricePerShareMultiple(address[]).details: Efficiently retrieves current prices for multiple yield sources

returns.pricesPerShare: Array of current prices for each yield source

getShareOutput(address,address,uint256).details: Rounds DOWN: shares credited for a deposit are never overstated.

params.assetIn: The underlying asset being deposited (e.g., USDC, DAI)
params.assetsIn: The amount of underlying assets to deposit, in the asset's native units
params.yieldSourceAddress: The yield-bearing token address (e.g., aUSDC, cDAI)

returns._0: shares The number of yield-bearing shares that would be received

getTVL(address).details: GLOBAL, MONITORING ONLY. Never a pricing input for any single strategy; total supply spans every      holder on the chain. Same caveat as `ERC20YieldSourceOracle.getTVL`.

params.yieldSourceAddress: The yield-bearing token address to check

returns._0: tvl The total value locked in the yield source, in underlying asset terms

getTVLByOwnerOfShares(address,address).details: Short-circuits to zero on a zero balance BEFORE touching any feed, so a strategy holding none of a      suspended instrument is still priceable. Same precedent as the UniV3 CLP oracle.

params.ownerOfShares: The address owning the yield-bearing tokens
params.yieldSourceAddress: The yield-bearing token address to check

returns._0: tvl The total value locked by the owner, in underlying asset terms

getTVLByOwnerOfSharesMultiple(address[],.details: Efficiently calculates TVL for multiple owners across multiple yield sources.      Returns a parallel `succeeded` mask so callers can distinguish genuine zero TVL      from entries that reverted (e.g. stale feed, unregistered position).      ROLLOUT NOTE: This function's return type changed from `uint256[][] memory` to      `(uint256[][] memory, bool[][] memory)`. Off-chain callers decoding with the old ABI      still read `userTvls` correctly (first head-word offset is unchanged), but decoding      old (pre-upgrade) oracles with the new ABI will mis-decode. Until all oracle deployments      are redeployed, the fleet has mixed signatures — off-chain services must use per-oracle      ABI awareness or batch the oracle redeploy with the service upgrade.

params.ownersOfShares: 2D array where each sub-array contains owner addresses for a yield source

returns.succeeded: 2D boolean mask — true if the TVL call succeeded, false if it reverted (value is 0)
returns.userTvls: 2D array of TVL values for each owner in each yield source

getTVLMultiple(address[]).details: Efficiently calculates total TVL across multiple yield sources

returns.tvls: Array containing the total TVL for each yield source

getWithdrawalShareOutput(address,address.details: Rounds UP: a withdrawal burns at least enough shares, favouring the vault over the withdrawer.

params.assetIn: The address of the underlying asset to be withdrawn (e.g., USDC, DAI)
params.assetsIn: The amount of underlying assets to withdraw, denominated in the asset’s native units
params.yieldSourceAddress: The address of the yield-bearing token (e.g., aUSDC, cDAI)

returns._0: shares The amount of yield-bearing shares that would be burnt after withdrawal

previewNav(address).details: Reverts for nothing. An unregistered instrument comes back with `registered == false` rather than a      revert, so the guard hook can produce a precise error and the OMS can pre-flight a leaf.

REGISTRY().notice: The approved-instrument list. The only source of feeds and cash denominations.

SUPER_LEDGER_CONFIGURATION().notice: Immutable address of the SuperLedgerConfiguration contract

decimals(address).notice: Returns the number of decimals of the yield source shares

getAssetOutput(address,address,uint256).notice: Calculates the number of underlying assets that would be received for a given amount of shares

getBalanceOfOwner(address,address).notice: Gets the share balance of a specific owner in a yield source

getPricePerShare(address).notice: Complete NAV of one whole bond token, in cash-token units

getPricePerShareMultiple(address[]).notice: Batch version of getPricePerShare for multiple yield sources

getShareOutput(address,address,uint256).notice: Calculates the number of shares that would be received for a given amount of assets

getTVL(address).notice: Calculates the total value locked across all users in a yield source

getTVLByOwnerOfShares(address,address).notice: Calculates the total value locked in a yield source by a specific owner

getTVLByOwnerOfSharesMultiple(address[],.notice: Batch version of getTVLByOwnerOfShares for multiple yield sources and owners

getTVLMultiple(address[]).notice: Batch version of getTVL for multiple yield sources

getWithdrawalShareOutput(address,address.notice: Calculates the amount of shares that would be burnt when withdrawing a given amount of assets
